questions.stem: A 66-year-old female comes to the OPD because of fatigue and oliguria for the past month, as well as hematuria for the past 2 days. After some lab investigations and a renal biopsy, she was diagnosed with chronic kidney disease. Which of the following would be the most likely in the patient's lab findings?

options.label: B
options.text: High level of blood urea nitrogen (BUN) and high level of creatinine.

options.label: C
options.text: A mean corpuscular value (MCV) of more than 100 fL.
